purpose: Typed discriminator for the B04-A Temporal Constraint boundary rule, separating boundary kind and temporal representation from the common rule envelope.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: MaterialStateRef of the Temporal Constraint rule revision owning this typed boundary discriminator.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one row for every B04-A boundary rule state.

columns.name: boundary_kind_code
columns.meaning: Boundary specialization activated for this rule state.

columns.name: temporal_form_code
columns.meaning: Truthful temporal representation of the boundary value.
columns.value_contract: B04-A admits exactly absolute; no silent conversion from date, floating-local or named-zone-local forms.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_boundary_state
primary_key.reason: At most one typed boundary discriminator per Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_boundary_state_constraint_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A boundary discriminator cannot exist without the owning Temporal Constraint rule envelope.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_boundary_state_kind
check_constraints.reason: B04-A activates only earliest-start; later boundary kinds belong to later B04 scope.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_boundary_state_temporal_form
check_constraints.reason: B04-A activates only exact absolute-instant boundary truth and fails closed for unsupported forms.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_boundary_state
indexes.reason: Boundary discriminator lookup by rule MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_boundary_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Require exactly one matching absolute boundary value for every accepted B04-A boundary rule state.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Immutable typed payload metadata owned one-to-one by the Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Currentness is inherited from the owning temporal_constraint_state through the shared scoped current binding; this row is not currentness authority.
state_history.chronology: No chronology is inferred from this discriminator; current-history episodes remain authoritative for accepted currentness.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime read access is SELECT-only; a changed boundary rule still produces a new MaterialState.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the owning historical rule MaterialState.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement changes currentness rather than erasing typed historical payload.

obligations: boundary kind is exactly earliest_start in B04-A
temporal form is exactly absolute in B04-A
unsupported forms cannot be silently coerced into absolute instants
typed payload totality is enforced at commit
